title: Visual imagery EEG dataset from Gao et al 2026
description: A 32-channel EEG dataset comprising visual imagery recordings from 22 healthy participants performing mental imagery tasks of animals, figures, and objects. The dataset includes 16,800 trials collected across 2 sessions per subject with 10 distinct imagery classes, sampled at 1000 Hz. This resource is designed to support brain-computer interface research and benchmarking of classification algorithms for imagery-based paradigms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuracle NeuSenW32 system with 32 Ag/AgCl electrodes positioned according to the standard 1005 montage, referenced to CPz with ground at AFz. Signals were sampled at 1000 Hz with a 50 Hz line frequency. Participants performed visual imagery tasks of 10 classes (animals, geometric figures, and objects) with 4-second trial intervals across 3 runs per session. Image cues were presented as visual stimuli in an offline, synchronous paradigm without feedback.
